evidence.reason: At the current tip, line 975 still fully materializes every child of a `.wants`/`.requires`/`.upholds` directory with `list(entry.iterdir())` before any `MAX_SCAN_ENTRIES` overflow check; line 980 then sorts that full list. A large directory can therefore consume unbounded memory and delay refusal despite the existing scan bound. This is an implementation gap in the intended bound, not merely a request for new protection scope.
